content.statement: The current returns policy v2 explicitly sets a 30-day full-refund window for standard items, so the claim is supported.
content.plan: Parsed policy_docs and base_retrieval, extracted numeric return windows, compared current v2 (30 days) against stale v1/judge reference (14 days), and checked order age 10 days against both windows; Cohen's d was not computable because no mean/sd fields were provided.

evidence.cohen_d_note: No mean_treat/mean_ctrl or sd_* fields present, so effect-size computation is insufficient.
